$description: Paper design tokens for Aplos Mail (plans/DESIGN.md section 4). The one source of truth: scripts/design/build-tokens.mjs generates ui/generated/tokens.css, motion.ts and contrast-pairs.json from this file. Conventions: $value is the light theme. $extensions.aplos.dark is the night value and $extensions.aplos.more the Increase Contrast value (both themes). A colour written as {mix, percent, over} is the base colour at that percentage over transparent, emitted as color-mix(in srgb, base p%, transparent); `over` is the surface it normally sits on, which the contrast check composites onto. Adding `solid: true` mixes into `over` instead (color-mix(in srgb, base p%, over)), so the colour is opaque and reads the same on any surface or fill. $extensions.aplos.usage says how a colour is used: a text or nontext colour must be the foreground of a contrast pair in every mode (a mode can be excused only by $extensions.aplos.unpairedModes, a map of mode to reason); a surface, decorative, shadow or overlay colour must be the background of a pair or carry $extensions.aplos.unpairedReason. Colour literals (hex, rgb(), hsl(), color-mix()) appear only in tokens of $type color. Pair minimums are 4.5 for text and 3 for nontext and cannot be lowered; the only accepted exception is the one listed in check-contrast.mjs. $extensions.aplos.css overrides the generated custom property name; groups set a cssPrefix. Extensions to the W3C format: $type spring (stiffness, damping, mass), motion (per-phase durations with rapid and reduced values), dimension values in ch and vh as well as px (measure-read 64ch, palette-top 16vh), a CSS angle carried as $type string (move.flight-rotate), shadow layers with an inset flag, and numbers with a unit in $extensions.aplos.unit. Units (DESIGN 11.6, everything is in rem): values here stay in px, the source of truth, and a group or token with $extensions.aplos.rem true has its px values emitted in rem (px / 16, trailing zeros trimmed, so 11px is 0.6875rem); `rem: false` on a token keeps it in px. Type sizes and line heights, spacing, control and keycap heights, rows and focus letters, layout and element sizes, icons and radii are rem; hairlines, the icon stroke, the focus ring width and gap, the commit edge, the select bar, the thread rail, progress tracks, segment heights, tracking (letter-spacing), shadows and motion travel stay px. Every --track-<role> is the role's letterSpacing plus var(--track-boost), which base.css raises on non-Retina screens. A typography token with $extensions.aplos.tabular true also emits --num-<role>: tabular-nums, because the font shorthand resets font-variant-numeric; pair font: var(--type-small) with font-variant-numeric: var(--num-small). The layer group holds the only z-index values (--z-*).

color.$description: Colour roles (DESIGN 4.1). Colour is rare: the accent appears only in its roles; hill, dusk and stamp only where they mean Done, Later or danger.

shell.$description: The window background; the sidebar sits on it with no fill. Cool-neutral (Lab b* below 0).

canvas.$description: The pane that lists, the reader, compose and settings sit on.

paper.$description: Cards on the pane: focus letter, inline reply, proposals, dialogs, menus, toasts. Lighter than the pane at night.

raised.$description: Quiet fills: the low-importance band, chips, attachments, the undo-send line.

ink-2.$description: Read senders, subjects, unread summaries and secondary text.

dim.$description: Metadata, timestamps, counts, placeholders, read summaries and disabled text.

faint.$description: Non-text only, on the pane: disabled icons and dividers. On the shell use dim.

line.$description: Hairlines: the pane edge, separators, the calendar grid.

aplos.unpairedReason: Hairline separators are decorative (WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply); under Increase Contrast it becomes the control edge, which is checked.

control-edge.$description: Checkbox, radio and switch-off edges only (3:1).

accent.$description: Ink blue: the one filled button, the focus ring, the cursor bar, the unread dot, links, today's date badge.

hill.$description: Done: Done fills, the Done commit edge, success.

dusk.$description: Later: Later fills, paused sync segments.

stamp.$description: Danger, the one red: Trash, errors, the recording meter, the calendar now-line, failed segments.

fill-ink.$description: Text and icons on hill, dusk and stamp fills.

aplos.unpairedReason: Shown only while a pointer is down (80 ms press); text on it is the same text that the hover pair checks one step lighter.

puck.$description: Sidebar selection, the keyboard cursor and segmented thumbs.

selection.$description: Selected text (::selection in base.css): the accent mixed into the pane, opaque, so selected text turns ink at the same contrast on any surface or fill (accent, hill, dusk, stamp included).

aplos.unpairedReason: Dims the app behind a dialog or the palette; nothing is read on the scrim itself.

shadow-ink.$description: The base colour for every shadow.

aplos.unpairedReason: Base colour mixed into the elevation shadows only.

sheen.$description: The 1 px top sheen on dark panes and cards; none in light.

aplos.unpairedReason: A 1 px inset highlight on dark panes and cards; decoration only.

tag.$description: Account, label and calendar colours (DESIGN 4.2), assigned by a stable hash of the name with a manual override. As marks each is at least 5.00:1 on the light pane and 6.59:1 on the dark pane.

sky.$description: Sky account, label and calendar colour.

hill.$description: Hill account, label and calendar colour.

stamp.$description: Stamp account, label and calendar colour.

dusk.$description: Dusk account, label and calendar colour.

sand.$description: Sand account, label and calendar colour.

ember.$description: Ember account, label and calendar colour.

event-fill.$description: Calendar event fill: the tag colour at this percentage, composited over the canvas so grid lines never cross the text.

font.$description: Three families. SF for everything; Newsreader only for words Aplos wrote (summaries and Ask answers); mono for addresses, code and citation numbers.

sans.$description: The system font (SF Pro): mail, controls, navigation and display lines.

serif.$description: Newsreader (variable, OFL, bundled). The two fallback faces are New York and Georgia scaled to Newsreader's metrics with size-adjust in assets/fonts/fonts.css, so nothing shifts when Newsreader arrives; plain New York and Georgia follow. Only for summaries and Ask answers.

mono.$description: Addresses in popovers, code and citation numbers.

type.$description: The ten type roles (DESIGN 4.3), the only font sizes allowed. Emits --type-<role> (a font shorthand) and --track-<role>; serif roles also emit --w-<role> and --opsz-<role>. SF uses weights 400, 500 and 600 only.

caption.$description: Keycaps, chips, calendar hours. The size floor.

small.$description: Metadata, timestamps, counts and sub-labels, always in dim with tabular numerals (--num-small); 500 for emphasis.

ui.$description: Sidebar, menus, controls and buttons; section labels at 600 in ink.

base.$description: List rows, settings rows and fields; unread senders at 600.

read.$description: Message bodies and the text you write, at the reading measure.

title.$description: Card and dialog titles, the reader's sender, the calendar's date label.

heading.$description: Only the compose subject field, the search field and onboarding step titles. There are no page titles.

display.$description: Welcome, inbox zero and the fatal error.

summary.$description: The one big line in Newsreader, identical on the Home focus letter and in the reader.

tracking.$description: Added to every type role's tracking (DESIGN 4.3): the generator emits --track-<role> as calc(<letterSpacing> + var(--track-boost)). base.css sets --track-boost to --track-boost-lowres on screens at 1.5 dppx or less.

boost.$description: The tracking added to every role; none on Retina screens.

boost-lowres.$description: The +0.005 em added on non-Retina displays (DESIGN 4.3).

read.$description: The reading measure for message bodies.

3.$description: 12 px step; the first section label sits this far below the pane header.

group-gap.$description: Between list sections and settings groups.

control.$description: Control heights. Every hit target is at least 24 x 24; the default is 28.

sm.$description: Small controls; the default hit target.

density.$description: Row and Home focus-letter heights per density (Settings > General). The focus letter is a fixed-height slot.

message-collapsed.$description: A collapsed message in a thread.

size.$description: Layout and element sizes (DESIGN 4.4, at a 1440 x 900 window).

shell-pad.$description: The pane's inset from the window on top, right and bottom; also the gap between the pane and the Ask dock.

sidebar-w.$description: Sidebar width, transparent on the shell.

list-w.$description: List column width, used as min(720px, 100% - 2 gutters), centred in the pane.

card-w.$description: The widest the email card gets in Go one by one (owner decision 2026-11-11, reference card about 625 px): a centred column that shrinks with the pane and never grows past this.

composer-w.$description: The composer page in the pane.

dock-w-narrow.$description: Ask dock width when the window is under dock-narrow-at.

dock-narrow-at.$description: Window width below which the dock uses dock-w-narrow.

palette-top.$description: Command palette distance from the top.

icon-sm.$description: Icons in chips and status lines.

commit-edge.$description: The edge that grows on the leaving side of a committed letter.

select-bar.$description: The accent bar on the keyboard cursor row's leading edge.

track.$description: Progress tracks: the status track and the undo-send drain.

focus-width.$description: Focus ring width; 3 px under Increase Contrast.

focus-gap.$description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

switch-pad.$description: Inset between switch track and thumb.

radio-dot.$description: The dot inside a selected radio.

radius.$description: The only radii (DESIGN 4.5). No primary button above 8 px.

xs.$description: Keycaps, the commit chip's icon well.

sm.$description: Chips, small controls, calendar events, the commit chip.

md.$description: Buttons (including the one filled button), rows, fields, menu items.

lg.$description: The pane, the Ask dock, cards, menus, popovers, the palette, toasts.

pill.$description: Only counts and search operator tokens. Never a button.

elev.$description: Elevation (DESIGN 4.6): hairline rings and soft shadows on opaque surfaces. No glass, no backdrop blur.

pane.$description: The pane and the Ask dock.

card.$description: The focus letter, the inline reply card, proposal cards.

float.$description: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, the palette; always on opaque paper.

dialog.$description: Dialogs and confirmations, with the scrim behind.

lift.$description: A dragged row or letter: the card elevation plus a deeper shadow.

puck.$description: The thumb of a segmented control.

thumb.$description: The switch thumb's shadow (carried from the mockups; DESIGN 4.6 does not list it).

layer.$description: Stacking layers, lowest to highest: the only z-index values (0 and auto stay literal). Emitted as --z-<name> and as layers in motion.ts.

sticky.$description: The pane header over the content scrolling under it.

dock.$description: The Ask dock and the sidebar over the pane while they slide.

dialog.$description: Dialogs and confirmations, with the scrim behind.

palette.$description: The command palette, with its scrim.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips, over everything, including dialogs and the palette.

press-feel.$description: The filled button's press feel (DESIGN 4.6): a 1 px inset highlight at the top and a 1 px inset shade at the bottom, swapped on :active.

hi.$description: Top inset highlight on the filled button.

aplos.unpairedReason: Inset highlight on the filled button; the label is checked as accent-ink on accent.

lo.$description: Bottom inset shade on the filled button.

aplos.unpairedReason: Inset shade on the filled button; the label is checked as accent-ink on accent.

spring.$description: Springs as stiffness / damping / mass (DESIGN 4.8). Compiled to a CSS linear() curve of 18 evenly spaced samples over the 0.5 % settle time, and to the solver in motion.ts for interruptible motion.

slide.$description: One shared puck: sidebar selection, D/W/M, Ask/Today, Settings nav, Later | Bookmarks. About 0.5 % overshoot.

snap.$description: Snap back, or onto a drop target, after a drag or swipe.

lift.$description: Lifting a dragged row or letter.

follow.$description: Following the pointer during drag and swipe (JS, per frame).

thumb.$description: The switch thumb only; the one spring allowed to bounce visibly (5.8 %).

motion.$description: Named motions (DESIGN 4.8). Durations are per phase; each emits --dur-<motion> or --dur-<motion>-<phase>. Rapid applies when triage keys arrive less than 300 ms apart; rapid is a duration map, same, or defer-until-hold (the motion waits for hold to end, then plays normally). Reduced applies under reduced motion; reducedMode says what still moves (none, opacity, colour, static or same). Transform and opacity only.

nav.$description: View, mailbox, account and settings-section switches: instant.

press.$description: Buttons, rows, keycaps: scale and inset swap; colour only when reduced.

hover.$description: Background and colour only, under (hover: hover). Never moves anything.

cursor.$description: The one shared list-cursor layer; focus is the Home focus letter. Zero on key repeat and pointer.

reveal.$description: Menus, popovers, tooltips: opacity, 4 px from the trigger, scale .98 to 1. Instant for reveal-grace after one closes.

settle.$description: Dialogs, the palette, proposal cards, the inline reply card: opacity, 8 px rise, scale .98, from the anchor.

slide.$description: One shared puck (translate and scaleX, never width).

commit.$description: Done, Later or Trash on the focus letter or in the reader: the commit edge grows, the chip fades and scales in.

carry.$description: A ghost row leaving any list: translateX 28 px, fading out.

flight.$description: The ghost letter on commit: translate (96, -12) px, rotate 2deg, fading from 40 %. From the burst key on, carry is used instead.

deal.$description: The next letter's content dealt into the fixed Home focus slot: opacity, 6 px rise.

hold.$description: Burst triage: rows below stay pinned until this long after the last key or the pointer leaves the row, capped.

close.$description: FLIP of the rows below after hold releases.

swap.$description: Reader J/K (double-buffered) and Later groups, overlapping: opacity and 12 px in the travel direction.

arrive.$description: New mail, a sent message in its thread, Ask cards: opacity and 6 px drop; neighbours FLIP. During rapid triage it waits until hold ends (rapid: defer-until-hold), then plays at 200 ms.

dock.$description: Ask dock and sidebar: contents translateX 24 px and fade; the main pane FLIPs. Never animate width.

undo-send.$description: The undo window (8 s default): a neutral 2 px bar drains scaleX 1 to 0. Static with a text countdown when reduced.

lift.$description: Drag start: scale 1.02 and the lift elevation.

follow.$description: Following the pointer during drag and swipe.

snap.$description: Snap back or onto a drop target; the armed swipe icon scales 1 to 1.08 to 1.

thumb.$description: The switch thumb (not one of the 23 named motions; it uses the thumb spring).

breathe.$description: Pending AI lines only, at most 3 on screen: ink-2 text between the breathe opacities. Static at breathe-static when reduced.

status.$description: A 30 % segment in a 2 px track, or the checklist marker, for the current first-sync step. Static when reduced.

count.$description: Sidebar counts: the old digit leaves 4 px up, the new one enters from 4 px below.

move.$description: Travel distances for the named motions. All become 0 under reduced motion.

deal.$description: Deal rise inside the focus slot.

swap.$description: Swap travel in the direction of movement.

carry.$description: Carry: the ghost row's sideways travel.

flight-x.$description: Flight: the ghost letter's sideways travel (right for Done, left for Later).

flight-y.$description: Flight: the ghost letter's vertical travel (up for Done, down for Later).

scale.$description: Scales for the named motions. All become 1 under reduced motion.

snap.$description: The armed swipe icon's peak scale.

breathe.$description: Opacities for the breathe loop on pending AI lines.

static.$description: The static opacity under reduced motion.

timing.$description: Timing rules around motion: toasts, the reveal grace, rapid detection and the theme switch.

toast-fade.$description: Toast fade-out after its life ends; 120 ms under reduced motion (opacity at most 120 ms).

reveal-grace.$description: After a menu, popover or tooltip closes, the next one reveals instantly for this long.

rapid-gap.$description: Triage keys closer together than this switch motions to their rapid values.

burst-window.$description: Window for counting burst keys; from the burst-keys-th key inside it, flight becomes carry.

spinner-delay.$description: Spinners appear only after this delay.

burst-keys.$description: From this key within burst-window, flight becomes carry.

theme-switch-frames.$description: Transitions are disabled for this many frames on a theme switch, so the app changes all at once (data-theme-switching).
